root_text:
🚨 HMPV Symptoms to Watch Out For!
Stay alert! The symptoms of Human Metapneumovirus (HMPV) include:
✔️ Cough
✔️ Fever
✔️ Nasal congestion
✔️ Shortness of breath
✔️ Runny or stuffy nose
✔️ Wheezing

#HealthAwareness  #HMPV #HMPVSymptoms #Sta
